my.title: My time
my.description: What your computer captured, one block per stretch of work. Accept or change each block so it counts as time on a ticket.
my.noDevice: No computer is sending time yet.
my.dayConfirmed: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to confirm} one {# block confirmed} other {# blocks confirmed}}

change.title: Change allocation
change.needTarget: Pick a ticket or an initiative.

split.title: Split block
split.hint: The block becomes two: before and after this time.

capture.title: Capture as task
capture.created: Task {ticket} created and the block confirmed to it

rules.description: A rule maps a block to a ticket or an initiative, or ignores it. Yours come first, then the team's.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Changing or ignoring a block offers to save one.
rules.teamHint: Team rules are set by a project owner.

setup.title: Time capture setup
setup.description: Four steps on the computer you work from. Each one is checked as it is done.

activitywatch.title: Install ActivityWatch
activitywatch.body: Download ActivityWatch and keep it running. It stores what you do on this computer only; the agent sends blocks of app, window title, domain and time, nothing else.
activitywatch.check: The agent reports that ActivityWatch answers.

apiKey.title: Create an API key
apiKey.body: The agent signs in to Plan with a personal API key. Create one and keep its value for the next step.
apiKey.check: At least one API key exists.

agent.title: Install the agent
agent.body: Run these in a terminal. Setup fills in the Plan API address and asks for the API key and a name for this computer.

sync.title: First sync
sync.body: Leave watch running. It syncs every 15 minutes, and yesterday's blocks appear in My time.
sync.check: A sync arrived in the last 24 hours.

calls.title: Calls (Mac)
calls.body: On a Mac with an iPhone signed in to iCloud, the agent can also read your call history. Grant Full Disk Access to your terminal in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then run watch with --calls.

banner.title: Set up time capture
banner.body: No computer has sent time in the last 24 hours. Set the agent up to log yesterday in three minutes a day.

team.title: Team setup
team.description: Who has the agent running and how much of this week is confirmed.
